summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The WisdomTree International Multifactor Fund (DWMF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of equities from developed market economies, excluding US and Canada selected by a proprietary methodology using various style factors. DWMF was launched on Aug 10, 2018 and is issued by WisdomTree.

holdings.infoBox: DWMF is an equity ETF with a total of 230 individual holdings. The top holdings are U.S. Dollar stock at 18.76%, ASML Holding at 2.33%, InterContinental Hotels Group at 1.53%, HSBC Holdings at 1.40%, and Novartis AG at 1.39%.
